prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 – Summary (under 500 words)

Core vision: A “Fair Deal” to replace a failing status quo, fix the NHS and social care, revive the economy, clean up rivers, tackle the climate crisis, and renew British democracy. Five themes: a fair economy; world‑class public services; environmental leadership; a strong UK with fair internationalism; and a truly fair democracy.

Economy and business
- Responsible public finances; restore stability and growth.
- Cut living costs via a national Home Energy Upgrade and a National Food Strategy; reduce mortgage pressures.
- Repair UK–EU trade, remove barriers, join key EU programmes, and work towards Single Market membership longer term.
- Green industrial strategy: invest in renewables, grid, skills and innovation; aim for 3–3.5% of GDP on R&D.
- Support SMEs: abolish business rates, replace with a Commercial Landowner Levy; expand British Business Bank; tackle late payments.
- Fairer tax: reverse bank tax cuts; one‑off windfall tax on oil/gas; raise Digital Services Tax to 6%; close CGT loopholes; 4% levy on FTSE‑100 share buybacks.
- Skills and work: replace apprenticeship levy with flexible skills levy; £5,000 Lifelong Skills Grants (aim £10,000); modernise gig‑economy rights; fix sick pay; expand parental leave and childcare; accessible AI regulation.

Health and social care
- Right to see a GP within 7 days (24 hours if urgent); recruit 8,000 GPs; expand pharmacists’ role; 24/7 booking.
- NHS dentistry access guaranteed for urgent needs; reform dental contract.
- Mental health: walk‑in hubs for young people; regular mental health check‑ups; specialist in every school; end out‑of‑area placements.
- Cancer: 100% start treatment within 62 days; more radiotherapy machines; more cancer nurses; faster access to new treatments.
- Social care: free personal care; Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/hour) and paid carers’ leave; Royal College of Care Workers; cross‑party funding deal; better respite for unpaid carers.

Climate, energy and environment
- Net zero by 2045; 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030.
- Ten‑year home retrofit with free insulation/heat pumps for low‑income households; rooftop solar push; decouple electricity prices from gas.
- Ban fracking and new coal; expand storage and interconnectors; enable community energy.
- End sewage scandal: turn water firms into public benefit companies, ban bonuses until leaks/discharges end, tougher regulator, Sewage Tax, real‑time spill data.
- Clean Air Act; “double nature” by 2050; plant 60m trees/year.

Education and families
- Per‑pupil funding up above inflation; rebuild and repair schools.
- Mental health professional in every school; “Tutoring Guarantee” for disadvantaged pupils.
- Early years: extra free hours for disadvantaged 3–4s; triple Early Years Pupil Premium.
- Reinstate university maintenance grants; expand Erasmus+; £5,000 Lifelong Skills Grants.
- Extend free school meals to all children in poverty.
- Parental leave: double statutory maternity/shared parental pay; 90%‑pay month for fathers/partners; day‑one rights incl. self‑employed.

Housing and communities
- Build 380,000 homes/year, incl. 150,000 social; 10 garden cities; zero‑carbon new homes.
- Abolish leasehold; cap ground rents; ban no‑fault evictions; default three‑year tenancies; end rough sleeping.
- Let councils end Right to Buy; control second homes/short‑lets.

Transport
- Accelerate EV rollout: far more chargers, restore plug‑in grant, 2030 zero‑emission sales.
- Freeze rail fares; new Railway Agency; major electrification; Northern Powerhouse Rail.
- Boost buses via franchising and simplified funding; maintain £2 fare cap; national active travel strategy.
- Shift freight to rail; curb aviation emissions, tax frequent flyers/private jets; moratorium on airport expansion.

Welfare, rights, crime, immigration
- Scrap two‑child limit and benefit cap; faster first UC payment; protect triple lock; expand carers’ support.
- Defend Human Rights Act/ECHR; Race Equality Strategy; make misogyny a hate crime; ban conversion therapy; scrap anti‑protest laws and live facial recognition.
- Community policing; attend all burglaries; clear court backlogs; Online Crime Agency; stronger action on VAWG.
- End Hostile Environment; scrap Illegal Migration Act/Rwanda; safe legal routes; three‑month asylum decision standard; allow work after three months; fairer work/family visas; protect EU citizens.

Political reform, defence, international
- Proportional representation (STV) for Commons and English councils; votes at 16; reform Lords; cap donations; written federal constitution and stronger devolution.
- Defence: reverse Army cuts; spend towards 2.5% of GDP; support NATO and Ukraine; maintain deterrent; tighter arms export controls; better housing and care for forces/veterans.
- Restore 0.7% aid; rebuild EU ties via staged roadmap; global human rights, climate leadership; immediate ceasefire and two‑state solution for Israel–Palestine; recognise Palestine.
